name: Sea Bright Solar
old_description: Sea Bright Solar uses the power of the sun to help customers from coast to coast save money—and the planet! Since 2003, Sea Bright Solar has helped thousands of homeowners and businesses generate their own renewable energy and reduce or eliminate their reliance on the grid. Serving New Jersey, New York, and Southern California, we provide customized, turnkey solar solutions. Our team consists of professional residential and commercial solar consultants, designers, engineers, and installation teams. Sea Bright offers extensive industry knowledge of the latest technology and best practices, as well as solar financing and incentives. Through our innovative solar system installations, we have helped both homeowners and businesses benefit by cutting energy costs up to 100%.
about:
Sea Bright Solar was founded in 2003 in Ocean Township, New Jersey. The company began with a focus on helping homeowners and businesses generate renewable energy through solar power, expanding over time to serve customers across New Jersey, New York, and Southern California.

The firm provides turnkey solar and home energy solutions. Its services span solar photovoltaic system design and installation, battery storage (including EcoFlow and SolarEdge systems), EV charging stations, and a Home Upgrade division that handles roofing (GAF-certified), siding (Norandex), gutters, whole-home generators (Generac), and main electrical panel upgrades. The company operates from three locations — Ocean, NJ; Staten Island, NY; and Redlands, CA — and holds active contractor licenses in each jurisdiction.

Sea Bright Solar serves residential and commercial customers seeking energy independence and lower utility costs. Its client base includes homeowners looking to combine solar with roofing or backup power, as well as businesses pursuing sustainability goals. The company also works with customers adding electric vehicles or planning home expansions that increase energy demand.

The company differentiates itself by consolidating multiple trades — roofing, electrical, solar, and generator installation — under a single licensed team, aiming to simplify project management and accountability. It emphasizes the use of high-performance, professional-grade products and over 20 years of combined experience.
